About me

Work with circuits, AI, and creative works.

Hi, I’m Frank. I was born in Chengdu and came to UIUC to study electrical engineering. I took a break from school to help build an industry-standard asset tag at Samsara, then jumped into startup life. I never formally studied computer science or marketing—which makes it slightly funny that I now do both full-time at a startup.
